name: Welcome to Azeroth
label: Quest
description: 'Welcome to Azeroth' marks the arrival of Skyborne travelers into the human capital of Stormwind via the Skyborne Portal. Reporting to Stormwind Keep…
intro: 'Welcome to Azeroth' marks the arrival of Skyborne travelers into the human capital of Stormwind via the Skyborne Portal. Reporting to Stormwind Keep, newcomers receive formal recognition and leave from Highlord Bolvar Fordragon to travel freely throughout Alliance lands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well met, adventurer. I am Bolvar Fordragon, regent to the throne of Stormwind.

A Kirin Tor messenger told me to expect to receive members of the High Order, and here you stand. It's been some time since a high elf has stood in this throne room, but I am glad to accept you now as a guest.
On behalf of the King, I welcome you to Stormwind and give you leave to travel freely through alliance lands. Welcome to Azeroth, Skyborne.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
